description: This file defines the 'TaxRate' controller class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for handling events related to tax rate operations such as adding, editing, and deleting tax rates by generating corresponding tasks.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax rate events in the admin panel of Opencart.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Handles the addition of new tax rate data by creating a task with geo zone ID.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Manages updating of tax rate data, generating tasks for old and new geo zone IDs if changed.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Handles deletion of a tax rate by creating an associated delete task.
